name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 14 - Am 16
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank – annual report 2024
part_text: 14a. Notes that the EIB’s exclusive branding as a ‘climate bank’ is unsustainable in the context of growing security threats, economic stagnation and Europe’s technological dependence; calls on the EIB to reconsider its strategic priorities and shift financing towards areas of higher public value, such as defence, industry, innovation and energy independence;
